verdict.rationale: Fenwick describes AI tools that analyze uploaded material: briefs are scanned to surface relevant uncited cases, and contract provisions are extracted and summarized for due diligence. These appear to be lawyer-operated tools rather than client self-serve features. The client-facing trademark extranet offers search, reporting and dashboards but no AI-generated insights, and the 'intelligent alerts for Patent clients' get only a single thin mention. Missing for 10: evidence of AI insights generated from the client's own data inside a client-facing product, details on what the intelligent alerts actually do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
